summary: Firy Inc. (formerly Skillz Inc.) filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on October 15, 2026 it completed the previously announced redemption of all $49,671,000 aggregate principal amount of its 10.250% Secured Notes due 2026 then outstanding. The redemption price was 100.000% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the redemption date; no Notes remain outstanding afterward. No board recommendation, advisor, or equity terms were disclosed. This is a routine debt retirement/capital-structure housekeeping event, not a special situation; watch for follow-on financing or liquidity commentary.
